name: What is the difference between a room addition and a home remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a room addition and a home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A room addition involves expanding your home's footprint by building new square footage, such as adding a new bedroom, bathroom, or family room. This typically requires new foundation, framing, roofing, and utilities. A home remodel, on the other hand, usually refers to altering or updating existing spaces within the current footprint, like renovating a kitchen or bathroom. While both improve your home, an addition provides new space, whereas a remodel enhances existing space.
acceptedAnswer.description: A room addition expands your home's square footage by building new space, while a home remodel updates or alters existing spaces within the current footprint.
